post.description: Sends a six-digit code to the address. A new address creates an account when the code is verified. The same answer comes back for every address.
Signs in with the code and sets the session cookie. The body never carries the session token.
Ends the session named by the cookie and clears it. A missing session still succeeds.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

get.description: Checks the state against the cookie, exchanges the code and signs in. A provider email that matches an existing account never signs in or merges: the answer is link_required, and the person confirms the link from that account in settings.

Returns the provider address to send the browser to, and sets a short-lived cookie that ties the callback to this browser. The request carries state and a PKCE challenge, and asks for name and email only.

post.description: Returns the options to pass to navigator.credentials.get. The challenge works once and expires after five minutes.
Verifies the signed challenge and sets the session cookie. Every failure answers the same way.
Takes a fresh sign-in code for the signed-in address, marks the session as recently authenticated and rotates the session cookie.

get.description: Returns the account behind the session or, for an API key, the account that issued it.
Lists the provider identities linked to your account. The email code is always available and is not listed.

delete.description: Removes a linked provider identity. It needs a fresh authentication and refuses to remove your last sign-in method.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

post.description: Links the provider identity from the last provider sign-in in this browser to your account. It needs a fresh authentication, and the provider email must match your account email.

get.description: Lists your registered passkeys, newest first. Keys and counters are never returned.

patch.description: Changes the label of one of your passkeys. It does not need a fresh authentication.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

delete.description: Removes one of your passkeys. It needs a fresh authentication and refuses to remove your last sign-in method.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

post.description: Two calls, both needing a fresh authentication. Phase options returns the creation options. Phase verify checks the new credential against that challenge and stores it.

get.description: Lists the signed-in devices, newest first. A person holds only a handful of sessions, so the list is never paged.

delete.description: Ends every session except the one making this request.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

delete.description: Ends one of your sessions. Revoking the session you are using also clears its cookie.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

session.name: __Host-drupflare_session
session.description: The session cookie set at sign-in.

apiKey.description: An API key that starts with dfk_. Session-only actions refuse keys.

ContractHeader.name: Drupflare-Contract
ContractHeader.description: The contract versions the client understands, as common=<min>-<max>. A server that cannot serve the range answers 426.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Repeat a write safely. The same key with the same request returns the first result.

RequestId.description: The id of this request. Quote it when you contact support.

Contract.description: The contract versions this server supports, as common=<min>-<max>.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the window frees a slot.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid. details.issues lists each field path.

Unauthenticated.description: The request has no valid session or API key.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not do this.

Unprocessable.description: The Idempotency-Key was used for a different request.

ContractUnsupported.description: The server does not support the requested contract range. details.supported names the range it does.

InternalError.description: The server failed. Quote the requestId when you report it.
